podcast.body: This song was initially released by The Trammps as a single and became a hit in clubs but struggled on pop radio, failing to reach the Top 40. Its fortunes drastically changed when it was included in the *Saturday Night Fever* soundtrack, playing in a memorable scene where Tony Manero dances with Annette. Inspired by disaster movies of the early 70s like *The Towering Inferno*, the title references a common theme of the era. "First, the title, disaster movies were all the rage in the early 70s, saying something about maybe the vibes of the era perhaps."
